version.changelog: Simplify the login instructions to the code flow (maton login prints a link; finish with maton login --code <CODE>), drop the API Key subsection, and pin the Maton CLI install to 0.4.0.

llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed Fathom integration that uses Maton OAuth to access meeting data and includes strong approval and data-forwarding safeguards.

dimensions.detail: The skill handles sensitive meeting transcripts and can configure persistent forwarding, but it clearly labels these risks, prefers platform-contained destinations, and warns against third-party or untrusted destinations without approval.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: It installs or uses the Maton CLI via pinned npm or Homebrew instructions and also documents SDK/raw HTTP fallbacks; these are disclosed and tied to the integration workflow.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill repeatedly requires explicit user approval for connection creation, writes, webhooks, hosted functions, trigger destinations, destination_url callbacks, and local --exec usage.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: OAuth tokens, webhooks, functions, and triggers can persist beyond a single task, but the artifact discloses this, instructs least privilege, and tells agents to delete or revoke unneeded resources.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is to retrieve Fathom meetings, transcripts, summaries, action items, and manage webhooks; the documented commands and API endpoints align with that purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before installing, understand that this skill can access sensitive Fathom meeting content and can create persistent webhooks or automations if you approve them. Use read-only actions where possible, confirm every destination URL and webhook scope carefully, and revoke/delete connections, functions, triggers, or webhooks when no longer needed.
